channel.title: Slow Orbit
channel.description: Slow, quiet lectures about the planets, the moons, the stars and the space between them, told calmly for the late hours. Read by a synthetic voice.

item.title: 3. Mars
item.description: The red planet, slowly: its rusted dust and blue sunsets, the greatest volcano and canyon in the Solar System, the old riverbeds, two small moons, and the patient machines that still work there. Read by a synthetic voice. Script written and fact-checked by the show's team.

item.title: 2. The Moon
item.description: Our only natural companion: its one face, its seas of old lava, its long days and nights, the tides, the visitors who walked there, and the mirrors they left behind. Read by a synthetic voice. Script written and fact-checked by the show's team.

item.title: 1. The Solar System
item.description: A slow journey outward from the Sun, past each planet in turn, to the edge of the Solar System. Read by a synthetic voice. Script written and fact-checked by the show's team.
